method: 1 sim-minute steps, 9 simulated days, days 1-8 scored (day 0 warm-up), paired agent vs rule-based BMS on identical weather/occupancy; CIs over days use t (n=8); across seeds t (n=10) on the per-run means
note: built by analyze.mjs from the run files listed in commands

seeds.note: default = coordinator v2 (results/v1/ holds the v1 runs; see v1vsV2). ?seed=N re-seeds occupancy, bookings, EV sessions and DR draws and adds day-to-day weather (±2 °C daily offset, cloudiness 0.65–1.0)

coordinator.note: v2 = the default (DR notice 60 min, forecast-aware battery, cost-based allocation); v1 = ?coord=v1, read from results/v1/ (committed before the switch)

seeds.note: paired by seed: v2 minus v1

coordinator.v1RunFiles: explicit coord=v2 runs (v2_*.json) are kept and equal the default runs

faultImpact.note: all 9 simulated days vs ?faultImpact=1 without faults (identical to the default run); operator = oracle approves real alarms / dismisses false ones every 5 min, an approved sensor is repaired 30 min later; the BMS world keeps every fault

methods: regression on forecast weather, occupancy timetable and yesterday (no future data)

definitions.horizon: made at the start of slot a-4 from data through slot a-5; the target slot a starts 60 min later
definitions.persistence60: slot a-4 (not yet complete when the forecast is made)

forecast.note: grid import, 1 h ahead, without future weather (see summary.json forecast.definitions)

demandCharge.source: KEPCO 2026-06-01 general service (B) HV-A option II: 8,320 KRW per kW-month (build/tariff_module.js)

full.note: no demand rate for this currency in the repo: pass --demandUSD=<rate per kW-month>

tuned.note: no demand rate for this currency in the repo: pass --demandUSD=<rate per kW-month>

v1vsV2.note: v1 = ?coord=v1, read from results/v1/ (the runs committed before the default switched); v2 = the default, read from results/. Same BMS, same inputs: differences are the agents' own. costSaveDiff = v2 − v1 in saving points, paired by day.

ablation.note: contribution = full saving − ablated saving (pp, paired by day). Under v2, ablate=COORD removes the negotiation / cost-based allocation only: the forecast-aware battery and the DR pre-cool stay inside the agents' plans.

limits.note: over-limit kWh / minutes over 8 days, with the coordinator and with ablate=COORD

defaultsUnchanged.note: old = run files in results/v1/ (committed before the default switched to v2); new = the same configuration re-run with coord=v1 (results/v1_*.json); max |difference| over every daily KPI of both controllers

commands: node analyze.mjs                      (optional: --demandUSD=<$ per kW-month> for the $ runs)
